description: NaMg₃Al(MoO₄)₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.74 Å. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.13 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AlO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.20 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.15 Å. There are five inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₆ octahedra and corners with five MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-59°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.87 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-56°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.85 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-53°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.82 Å. In the fourth Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with five MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-60°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.83 Å. In the fifth Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-55°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.88 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.03 Å. There are twenty inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Mg and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Mo and one Al atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Mg and one Mo atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Mg and one Mo atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Mo atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Al atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Al atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Mo, and one Al atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one Al atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Mg, one Mo, and one Al atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Mo atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Mg and one Mo atom. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Mg and one Mo atom. In the nineteenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Mo atom. In the twentieth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom.
